decision.reason: Coordinated route-aware repair clears reported electrical violations, clears the setup floor and lowers overflow. Two negative hold paths, six reserve shortfalls and nonzero congestion prevent qualification. Two higher-margin continuation attempts fail in pinned hold repair and produce no final candidate.
decision.next_gate: Repair and test the pinned empty-load hold-insertion failure, then measure a bounded clock/hold-aware continuation through another complete route. Preserve the stronger first-pass candidate and the unchanged reference.
